the wideband MIMO propagation characteristics of 580 MHz and 2.35/4.90 GHz in urban micro- (macro-)cell are different, but the frequency dependency is weak.

the wideband MIMO measurements in urban micro- (and macro-) cells can be used to validate the MIMO models for urban micro- (or macro-) cell environments.
the urban microcell is more suitable for the high-speed data services and the urban macrocell is more suitable in the high-frequency applications.
